noisy_center.selection: First two bent source ids by predetermined panel order with an admitted present draw. Use earliest admitted draw.

viewed.observations: Both standing camera families were reviewed at 160 native pixels per cell. Both cab priors retain their original incomplete and sometimes regular crossings, with some mottle. Main coarse crossing contrast changes subtly. No added sky structure. The noisy-center synthetic pairs show small contrast improvements in a few weave intersections and still miss much of the exact weak texture.
